==Quest information==
===Requirements===
*This quest is only offered to [[level]] 20 [[character]]s.

===Objectives===
*Win a battle in the [[Random Arenas]].
*See Zenjal <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen Order|Zaishen]] Guide] for your reward.

===Reward===
*5,000 [[Experience]]
* [[Gladiator's Zaishen Strongbox]]

==Walkthrough==
See [[Random Arenas#Tips]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide]
:''"There is merit in the will to compete, but glory comes from victory. You have proven that you have the spirit to stand in the Random Arenas, but can you stand triumphant?"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I have never lost a battle, and I never will.
| decline = Let's give peace a chance.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue ===
;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide]
:''"To compete in the Random Arenas, you must journey to the Battle Isles.  If you wish, I can send you directly to [[Random Arenas (outpost)|the staging area]].  Is your heart prepared for the flames of battle?"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = Let's do it.
| decline = Not now.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zenjal [Zaishen Guide]
:''"You have survived and prevailed! Take your well-earned rewards and steel yourself for the next battle."''

==Notes==
*Unlike [[The Path to Combat: Random Arena]], this quest's name uses [[:File:Zenjal RA quest names.jpg|plural ''"Arenas"'']].
